name: Rent mailbox
summary: One roommate fronts the rent and everyone pays them back: a curbside mailbox where each roommate's envelope (their share by room) flies in when they mark it sent; the flag goes up when all are in, and stragglers get a request in one tap.
useWhen: rent is due and one roommate pays the landlord: 'rent's due the 1st, arun's fronting it'
uneven room shares: '$825, $825, $760 for the small room, $890 with the bathroom'
chasing roommates who haven't sent their rent share
dontUseWhen: working out what each room should cost (use rent-split)
a one-off shared purchase (use a bill split)

fronter.description: Who pays the landlord and gets paid back

shares.description: 2 to 6 roommates and their share in cents

sent.description: Roommates who already paid the fronter back
